MonoPaint 0.9 adds oil paint brushes that run out of paint and smudge.

- Oil paint: turn it on for any brush in its settings. Each stroke starts with
  solid paint in your shade, then runs out along the stroke and smudges the
  paint underneath; an empty brush leaves clean paper clean. Wider strokes use
  paint faster. Works on dry, transparent and wet canvases.
- Load an oil brush by rubbing the pen around in the color bar or a palette
  swatch: a tap loads a little, and more rubbing loads more. Loading speed and
  Minimum load settings adjust how much.
- With oil paint, the Filbert becomes a crescent, so a stroke starts with a
  thin rounded sliver.
- Brush pen: a Carry original paint setting pushes the paint it picks up
  further along the stroke.

Download **monopaint.apk** and follow the [sideload instructions](https://github.com/mpdairy/monopaint#sideload-onto-a-manta).
Update with `adb install -r monopaint.apk` to preserve drawings and settings.
The application ID and signing identity are unchanged from MonoPaint 0.85.
Android version code 42 allows this release to update 0.85 and earlier builds.

`SHA256SUMS` contains the APK checksum. This is a signed, non-debuggable release build.
